Description: Infection due to contact with infective patients in the community (rate β), hospitalized patients (rate θ), or dead patients at funerals (rate φ)
Progression from latent phase to infectious state after incubation period (rate α)
Hospitalization of infectious individuals (rate η)
Recovery of infectious individuals in the community (rate (1-δ)γ)
Death of infectious individuals in the community (rate δγ)
Recovery of hospitalized patients (rate (1-δH)γH)
Death of hospitalized patients (rate δH·γH)
Patients abandoning healthcare facilities and returning to community (rate κ)
Burial of dead patients (rate b)
